title: Refusal of registration — the route to a remedy

steps.title: Sub-Registrar refuses
steps.text: Order with reasons in Book No. 2; 'registration refused' endorsed; free copy of reasons

steps.title: Ground other than denial of execution
steps.text: Appeal to the Registrar within 30 days

steps.title: Ground of denial of execution
steps.text: Application to the Registrar within 30 days; enquiry into execution and compliance, with civil-court powers

steps.title: Registrar refuses
steps.text: No appeal; order of refusal with reasons

steps.title: Civil suit within 30 days
steps.text: Decree directing registration; other remedies on the unregistered document not lost
